can we reduce l_entry scope to within if condition ?
Done
todo statement is not clear.
Can you elaborate what is not clear?

Why a TODO is required here. A standard exception is caught and that is being set in the error code. I find the code to be perfect here.
Any future enhancement will be on need basis, a TODO reflects that something is missing and needs to be fixed in future, which I don't see here.

`commonUtility::executeCmd` or `commonUtility::toLower` can throw exception. Right now error code is not implemented in them. When error codes are implemented in those APIs, we need to handle that in this `catch` block.

No, I would disagree, once error code is implemented, even then handling won't be required in catch block.
Since the catch block is handling std::exception, the error code that you are currently setting would suffice.

If we traverse both the scenarios.

As per current situation:
If those API throws then they are standard exception which is going to be caught in catch and error code will be set. Hence no TODO required.

In future:
When those API's will return error codes for non std::exception type of error, then those error codes will be checked just after the API is called and if set will be logged and function will return from there. So even in that case code will not reach the catch block for those errors, making TODO invalid.
Understood. Removed the TODO comment.
